newsitem.title: UK: Medeva profits surge, but shares slide.
newsitem.headline: Medeva profits surge, but shares slide.

text.p: British pharmaceuticals group Medeva Plc on Wednesday posted a 35 percent jump in interim pre-tax profits, but shares in the company fell sharply as investors reacted with disappointment.
Medeva said pre-tax profit rose to 47 million pounds ($78.8 million), with sales 30 percent higher at 159 million pounds.
However the results were at the lower end of analysts' forecasts and shares slid 33 1/2 pence to 223 pence in early trading.
The market chose to focus on problems facing a U.S. anti-obesity drug acquired by Medeva last year, which has seen sales slump on the back of health scares.

The company also warned that the possible advent of competition for its biggest-selling drug for attention deficit disorder and the continued impact of a strong pound would be key factors in its second-half performance.
Medeva, which has built up an international operation by acquiring existing businesses and products, announced it had bought rights to a new bladder cancer drug under development in the U.S.
It also said it had bought a Belgian drug marketing company for 4 million pounds and tied up a sales distribution agreement in Europe for its anaesthetic gases business.
